citations.quote: In relative valuation, the objective is to value assets based on how similar assets are currently priced in the market.
Multiplier models (synonym: market multiple models). These models are based chiefly on share price multiples or enterprise value multiples.
For Pfizer the price-to-book ratio is: Price-to-book ratio = Market price per share/Book value of equity per share

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Framing relative valuation as a sibling of intrinsic valuation: standardize the target's price by an accounting metric (earnings, book value, sales), choose comparable firms, and compare the target's multiple to the peer distribution. P/E is the canonical equity multiple; the four-step relative-valuation process organizes the work.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: P/E and Relative Valuation
